interpretation.text: READINESS FAIL (informative, NOT a claim verdict): with MECH-307 genuinely ON, the FULL arm still does not clear the RANDOM baseline by >= 0.05 on >= 2/3 seeds (G0_ON), on a live/discriminating P2 window. MECH-307 reachability alone does not restore the G0 gate -- consistent with the still-open curriculum gap (z_goal starved before P2). Route to the substrate_queue stub `scaffolded-curriculum-hazard-rebalance` FIRST, then re-run this readiness gate; do NOT force through to the discriminative retest. mech307_perturbs_baseline=FALSE: the OFF arm also fails G0, so this is the pre-existing curriculum gap (866a reproduced), not a MECH-307 regression.
